verdict.rationale: SerpApi's pricing page documents a Free $0/month plan with 250 searches per month, repeated on the use-case pages. It says to "start for free, upgrade as you grow", so a developer can prototype without paying. Two things stretch the allowance further: cached searches are free and do not count toward monthly searches, and a live interactive playground is available for testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the free tier needs no payment details and covers all engines and features.
